newsitem.title: USA: Boise Cascade Office sets 7 acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Boise Cascade Office sets 7 acquisitions.

text.p: Boise Cascade Office Products Corp said Thursday it completed the acquisitions of or agreed to acquire a total of seven companies which represent annual revenues of $90 million.
Boise Cascade said it has signed a letter of intent to acquire Oregon Wholesale Novelty Company Inc, an advertising specialties company with annual revenues of $30 million.

It also completed acquisition of Mike Bryan Office Products in Oklahoma and signed letters of intent to acquire five other contract stationers. Total annual revenues of the contract stationers being acquired are about $60 million.
The company expects to close the transactions by the end of October.
Boise Cascade said the contract stationer acquisitions will improve its distribution coverage in the U.S. and add to international operations."

The announced acquisitions will be supplemented by internally generated growth, it said in a statement. The company recently started up new distribution centers in Miami and Las Vegas. It is also continuing to move forward on the roll-out of its computer supplies product offering and integrating the distribution portion of its direct-marketing business with its contract stationer distribution system.
